A1.subject: Mortgage Status
A1.body: Is my mortgage application still pending now and why? What can I do next?
A1.label: Case A · Inbound · Mike · Mortgage Status

A2.subject: Reply to Mortgage Status
A2.body:
Hello Mike,

Your appraisal has been completed, but the underwriting review is still pending because your income verification is still being completed.

Next step: Once income verification is complete, the underwriter will review your application and determine whether any additional information is needed.

We'll notify you when your application moves to the next stage.

Best Regards,
Finance CX AI Agent
A2.disclosure: This email was generated by an AI assistant based on your current mortgage application information. If further review is required, a loan specialist will follow up.
A2.label: Case A · Outbound · Status reply

B1.subject: Strange Transaction
B1.body: I don't recognize this $4,800 transaction at a jewelry store. Could you refund?
B1.label: Case B · Inbound · Emily · Strange Transaction

B2.subject: Re: Strange Transaction — Documents Needed
B2.body:
Hi Emily,

Thank you for contacting us about the $4,800 jewelry-store transaction. We have opened Case #4821.

To continue the dispute review, please upload a clear photo or PDF of the receipt / statement for this charge using the secure link below within 48 hours:
https://bank.com/secure/collect/4821

We cannot process a refund until documentation is received and a specialist completes the review.

Best Regards,
Finance CX AI Agent
